cards.english: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.
cards.zh-tw: 會閃爍臀部的光芒來與夥伴交流。最喜歡甜甜螢放出的甜甜香氣。

cards.english: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.
cards.zh-tw: 會誘導電螢蟲在夜空中描繪記號。也有些學者在研究記號的含意。

cards.english: It prefers to avoid groups. In its day-to-day life, it dexterously controls its vines to compensate for its short arms.
cards.zh-tw: 生性不愛群體行動。在生活中會靈巧操縱藤蔓來代替短短的手臂。

cards.english: Servine's one weakness is its inflated sense of pride. It takes a while for Servine to be able to cooperate with other Pokémon.
cards.zh-tw: 小缺點是自尊心過高。需要不少時間才能與其他寶可夢合作。

cards.english: An intimidating gaze and majestic appearance have caused this Pokémon to be known as the Lord of the Forest.
cards.zh-tw: 擁有能讓對手畏怯的眼神以及威風凜凜的身姿，因此被稱為森林的君主。

cards.english: Wavering flames similar to those of the sun appear on the surface of this Pokémon's body.
cards.zh-tw: 身體表面會產生像太陽一樣的火焰熱浪。

cards.english: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.
cards.zh-tw: 聯絡夥伴和追趕獵物的時候，會分別發出不同種類的叫聲。

cards.english: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.
cards.zh-tw: 聽見牠恐怖長嚎的寶可夢會渾身發抖，一溜煙地回到自己的巢裡。

cards.english: Twigs make for Fennekin's snacks. When it nibbles on twigs, it finds the courage to face strong foes.
cards.zh-tw: 小樹枝是火狐狸的零食。卡滋卡滋地啃著啃著就會湧出對抗強敵的勇氣。

cards.english: Braixen's branch ignites as it's pulled from the Pokémon's tail. Braixen then uses the flame to spark powerful attacks.
cards.zh-tw: 將樹枝從尾巴拔出時就會著火。牠會用點燃的火當火種，使出強力的招式。

cards.english: It controls flames telekinetically, trapping its foes in a fiery vortex surpassing 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit and burning them to a crisp.
cards.zh-tw: 能用念力操控火焰。攝氏３０００度的火焰旋渦會包圍對手並將其燒成灰燼。

cards.english: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.
cards.zh-tw: 有著能夠理解人類語言的高度智慧，是喜歡在背上載著人類在大海游泳的寶可夢。

cards.english: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.
cards.zh-tw: 會迎著海風如滑翔機般滑翔。到了冬天就會將食物藏在巢的周圍。

cards.english: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.
cards.zh-tw: 會把孩子放進鳥嘴裡保護。風平浪靜的日子會漂浮在海面上稍作休息。
由於與野蠻鱸魚的生態相差甚鉅，故將兩者視為不同種類的說法在近年被認為最為有力。
sources: PokeOS localized card image B4a-017 zh, manually transcribed and reviewed

cards.english: It can jump with incredible power. Parts of its body are tinged red by the rage of its fallen friends.
cards.zh-tw: 擁有驚人的跳躍力。死去的夥伴們的怒火染紅了牠的身體。

cards.english: It’s usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.
cards.zh-tw: 會出現在發電廠等地方。很多人會把牠錯當成精靈球去觸碰而被電麻。

cards.english: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of the Bomb Ball.
cards.zh-tw: 稍微受點刺激就會爆炸，因此得到了炸彈球的外號，被人們深深恐懼。

cards.english: This Pokémon prefers places with lots of lightning strikes. It catches lightning with its mane and stores the electricity within its body.
cards.zh-tw: 喜歡經常發生落雷的土地。會用鬃毛接下雷電，把電力儲存到體內。

cards.english: Once the herd hears thunder, it chases after the storm clouds so that the Blitzle in the group can use the lightning to charge up.
cards.zh-tw: 為了讓群體裡的斑斑馬能透過雷電充電，只要一聽到雷鳴聲，就會成群追趕雷雲。

cards.english: This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.
cards.zh-tw: 生性膽小，光是碰到海藻屑就足以讓牠嚇得放電。嘴唇不會導電。

cards.english: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
cards.zh-tw: 總是一副在發呆的樣子，不知道在想些什麼。擅長用尾巴來釣食物。

cards.english: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.
cards.zh-tw: 據說當牠抽動凸出的鼻子，無論是誰在哪裡做著什麼夢，都會被牠知道得一清二楚。

cards.english: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.
cards.zh-tw: 會以固定的節奏擺動著形影不離的鐘擺。一靠近牠就會不由自主地昏昏欲睡。

cards.english: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.
cards.zh-tw: 擅長表演默劇。用手指放出的波動製造牆壁，保護自己免於大多數的攻擊。
某位科學家的研究造就了夢夢的誕生，牠的力量專為戰鬥而存在。
sources: PokeOS localized card image B4a-030 zh, manually transcribed and reviewed

cards.english: Behind an Espurr's expressionless face is a frantic struggle to contain psychic power.
cards.zh-tw: 雖然看起來面無表情，但其實內心正非常努力地在控制自己的精神力量。
一旦感知到危險，就會釋放最高強度的精神力量，導致連自己都不會記得當時的事。
sources: PokeOS localized card image B4a-032 zh, manually transcribed and reviewed

cards.english: This Pokémon lives quietly in the depths of the forest. The purple, cape-like fur gets longer and longer as Oranguru ages.
cards.zh-tw: 在森林深處過著安靜的生活。如同斗蓬般的紫色體毛會隨著年齡而越變越長。

cards.english: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.
cards.zh-tw: 棲息在老舊的寶箱中。有時會因沒人注意到自己是寶可夢，而被擱置在道具店的角落。
頭上戴著死去母親的頭骨。雖然有時會因為作夢而哭泣，但每次流淚後都會變得更強。
sources: PokeOS localized card image B4a-035 zh, manually transcribed and reviewed

cards.zh-tw: 進化時，原本戴在頭上的頭骨跟著化為了牠身體的一部分。不但如此，性格也變得很凶暴。
sources: PokeOS localized card image B4a-036 zh, manually transcribed and reviewed

cards.english: From the forces of lightning and wind, it createsenergy to give nutrients to the soil and make theland abundant.
cards.zh-tw: 吸收風與雷後轉化成的能量能夠給予土壤營養，讓大地變得豐饒。

cards.english: A very common sight in grasslands and such. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.
cards.zh-tw: 大量棲息於草地等處。會快速顫動吐出的舌頭，藉此感知周遭的危險。

cards.english: This Pokémon is very tenacious. Once it targets its prey, it won't give up the chase, no matter how far the prey goes.
cards.zh-tw: 性情非常執著。一旦鎖定了獵物，便會窮追不捨。

cards.english: When two of these Pokémon’s bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.
cards.zh-tw: 當臭泥彼此黏在一起，身體就會互相融合，進而產生新種毒素。

cards.english: It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.
cards.zh-tw: 奇臭無比！身體帶有劇毒，舉凡所經之處，任何草木都會枯萎。

cards.english: The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air. That's why it's always slightly airborne.
cards.zh-tw: 體內的毒瓦斯成分比空氣來得輕一點，所以總是微微浮在空中。

cards.english: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.
cards.zh-tw: 會透過團隊合作，一隻負責引開雙親的注意，一隻負責偷走蛋，非常地狡猾奸詐。

cards.english: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.
cards.zh-tw: 在危急時刻會把身體捲成一團、倒豎起背上的尖刺，不分青紅皂白地發出電擊。

cards.english: Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed.
cards.zh-tw: 能夠舉起重達５噸的貨物。天一亮就會成群結隊前往洞窟找礦石來吃。

cards.english: Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.
cards.zh-tw: 自尊心強，脾氣刁鑽。皮膚的綠色越是鮮豔，就越受到同伴的尊敬。

cards.english: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.
cards.zh-tw: 敲打鐵屑來製作錘子。直到做出自己滿意的作品前，會一次又一次地重做。

cards.english: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.
cards.zh-tw: 棲息在堆滿破銅爛鐵的地方。為了測試錘子的強度，會和夥伴們激烈地敲打彼此。

cards.english: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.
cards.zh-tw: 會輕鬆地揮舞著超過１００公斤的錘子來奪取想要的東西，然後帶回自己的住處。

cards.english: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.
cards.zh-tw: 堆疊硬幣而形成的身體結實堅固。會連續發射硬幣來壓制敵人。

cards.english: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.
cards.zh-tw: 生活在被地熱加溫的洞窟裡。如果有敵人靠近，就會從洞裡撲出來大口咬住。

cards.english: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
cards.zh-tw: 最喜歡閃閃發光的東西，所以會把在洞窟裡找到的寶物積存到自己的巢穴裡。

cards.english: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.
cards.zh-tw: 頭上長著的２個突起物是作為感應器的用途。就連遠處獵物的狀況也能察覺。

cards.english: Its metal body is durable but prone to retaining heat. It vents this heat from the slits in its tail.
cards.zh-tw: 金屬構成的身體雖然堅固但無法散熱，因此牠會從尾巴上的縫隙排出熱氣。

cards.english: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It's so durable that being caught in a cave-in won't faze it.
cards.zh-tw: 會在山裡挖洞來尋找食物。身體非常堅硬，即使遇到洞穴坍塌也絲毫不會在意。

cards.english: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.
cards.zh-tw: 全身是由龍之能量的結晶打造而成。據說牠擁有所有的龍寶可夢的力量。
生命力很強，即使在骯髒的地方也能安然生活。放任不管的話會不停繁殖。
sources: PokeOS localized card image B4a-058 zh, manually transcribed and reviewed

cards.english: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.
cards.zh-tw: 非常喜歡耀眼的發光物。找到發光物時，不知為何額頭的金幣也會跟著發光。

cards.english: It has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. This is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.
cards.zh-tw: 性情凶暴，豎起尾巴時要多加小心。那是牠將飛撲過來咬你的前兆。
能夠改變體色，融入景色中，偷偷地靠近獵物。但腹部的花紋是不會消失的。
sources: PokeOS localized card image B4a-062 zh, manually transcribed and reviewed

cards.english: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.
cards.zh-tw: 深信白白圓圓的石頭是蛋，很小心翼翼地拿著。很在意自己捲毛的形狀。

cards.english: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
cards.zh-tw: 如果放著不管，體毛就會不斷變長，但牠只允許信賴的人幫自己修剪。

cards.english: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.
cards.zh-tw: 只吃精挑細選過的食物。蟲寶可夢很討厭牠身上散發的那種聞起來像是香草的氣味。
喜好乾淨，個性一絲不苟。會讓花香包覆全身來療癒周圍的寶可夢們。
sources: PokeOS localized card image B4a-066 zh, manually transcribed and reviewed

cards.english: It controls flames telekinetically, trapping its foes in a fiery vortex surpassing 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit and burning them to a crisp.
cards.zh-tw: 能用念力操控火焰。攝氏３０００度的火焰旋渦會包圍對手並將其燒成灰燼。

cards.english: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.
cards.zh-tw: 會以固定的節奏擺動著形影不離的鐘擺。一靠近牠就會不由自主地昏昏欲睡。

cards.english: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.
cards.zh-tw: 會輕鬆地揮舞著超過１００公斤的錘子來奪取想要的東西，然後帶回自己的住處。
能夠改變體色，融入景色中，偷偷地靠近獵物。但腹部的花紋是不會消失的。
sources: PokeOS localized card image B4a-076 zh, manually transcribed and reviewed

cards.english: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.
cards.zh-tw: 深信白白圓圓的石頭是蛋，很小心翼翼地拿著。很在意自己捲毛的形狀。

cards.english: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.
cards.zh-tw: 只吃精挑細選過的食物。蟲寶可夢很討厭牠身上散發的那種聞起來像是香草的氣味。

cards.english: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.
cards.zh-tw: 隨著身體的成長，溫暖的６根尾巴的毛髮也會變得更漂亮。

cards.english: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.
cards.zh-tw: 擁有金光閃閃的體毛以及９根長長的尾巴。據說壽命長達１０００年。

cards.english: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.
cards.zh-tw: 背鰭和尾鰭像肌肉那樣發達。能夠以５節的速度在水中游泳。

cards.english: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.
cards.zh-tw: 金魚王之所以會用角挖穿河底的岩石來築巢，是為了防止產下的卵被水流沖走。

cards.english: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.
cards.zh-tw: 任性且非常愛撒嬌。體內的兩個囊袋分別儲存著毒和電。

cards.english: Sinistea gets into your body when you drink it, and then it steals your vitality from within. It also tastes awful.
cards.zh-tw: 會趁著自己被喝掉時進到對方身體裡，從內部奪走其生物能量。喝起來很難喝。

cards.english: These Pokémon multiply by creeping into teapots and pouring themselves into leftover tea.
cards.zh-tw: 會潛入茶壺裡，然後把自己倒進喝到一半的紅茶裡來使茶量變多。

cards.english: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.
cards.zh-tw: 大嘴娃能用自己那由鋼角變化而成的巨大顎部將對手一口緊緊咬住。
不擅長應付寒冷的季節。為了尋找溫暖的地帶，會1天飛上300公里的距離。
sources: PokeOS localized card image B4a-103 zh, manually transcribed and reviewed

cards.zh-tw: 發現居住在森林裡的獵物時，會從高空俯衝而下，用銳利的爪子捕捉獵物。
sources: PokeOS localized card image B4a-104 zh, manually transcribed and reviewed

cards.english: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.
cards.zh-tw: 堆疊硬幣而形成的身體結實堅固。會連續發射硬幣來壓制敵人。
